steps.instruction: Type 'classes.berkeley.edu' into the search bar and press Enter.
Click on 'course offerings - Berkeley Class Schedule' to go to classes.berkeley.edu.
Click on 'Archive' to look for past class schedules including Fall 2023.
Click on 'Show more' under the Term section on the left sidebar to reveal more semesters.
Scroll down the page to view more term filters including Fall 2023.
Scroll down the left sidebar to find and select Fall 2023.
Scroll up to the top of the page to view the search bar and filter controls.
Type 'Computer Science' into the search box to filter for Computer Science courses.
Click 'Search' to execute the search for Computer Science courses.
Scroll down the left sidebar to view the course level, day, and time filter options.
Click on 'Graduate' under Course Level in the left sidebar to filter for graduate-level courses.
Click on 'Tu' under Days Offered in the left sidebar to select courses held on Tuesdays.
Click on '2:00 pm - 4:00 pm' under Start Time in the left sidebar.
Click on '4:00 pm - 6:00 pm' under Start Time in the left sidebar to include courses starting between 4:00 PM and 6:00 PM.
The graduate-level computer science courses for Fall 2023 on Tuesdays between 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM have been found.
